opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties from which they can be relieved, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants required covering a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven cross-disciplinary research at the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities, in partnership with the Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering and supported by the Leverhulme Trust.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library or museum (GLAM organisation) or a performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany to encourage collaboration and networking, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate location; any nationality with a UK doctorate eligible; must have completed Viva Voce between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027 and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK with a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Promotes acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination, including quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute with an established role lasting the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status, planning at least 20% FTE on the award. Involvement of overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: Supports projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences working with international partners on genuinely interdisciplinary projects ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines on the theme of Mobilities.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships providing opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in policy sectors, embedding the award holder in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000 (exceptional circumstances above £4,000 considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support to make an application.
